app_description: A playful multiplayer bingo where you match dog breeds, chase paw-some lines, and celebrate with a happy woof!
start_game_description: Name your room and pick a nickname. Friends can join with the invite code.
join_game_description: Enter a room code and nickname to join your friends.
settings_description: Game preferences will live here. This feature is coming soon.
tutorial_intro: Bindog is a dog-themed twist on classic bingo. Gather friends, fill your card, and race to shout Bindog!
tutorial_bingo_body: Each player gets a card with little pictures on it. When someone calls out a picture, mark it if it is on your card. Make a full line across or up and down to win!
tutorial_bindog_body: Every picture on your card is a dog breed. When a breed is called, mark it if you have it. The first player to finish a full line wins the round. Woof!
tutorial_multiplayer_body: One friend makes a room and shares a secret code. Everyone else types that code on their own phone or computer. Then you can all play together, even if you are in different houses!
lobby_share_hint: Share this code so friends can join.
lobby_waiting_for_leader: Waiting for the leader to start…
leave_confirm_description: You will disconnect from this room. You can join again with the invite code if it is still open.
not_found_description: That page scampered off to chase squirrels. Let's get you back to the park.
error_invalid_code: That room code is not valid.
error_connection_failed: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
error_need_two_players: Need at least two players to start.
game_bingo_disabled_hint: Mark a full row or column first
game_waiting_restart: Waiting for the leader to restart…
game_players_left_description: All the other players left the room, redirecting to the home page.
